course.title: Power System I
course.department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

content.value: A sampler is used to sample signals from four input channels having frequencies 1.0 kHz, 2.0 kHz, 3.0 kHz and 4.0 kHz. The signals are sampled at minimum Nyquist rate and encoded by 256-level encoder. If the obtained PCM sequences are time multiplexed, calculate the number of bits in a PCM frame, frame rate and bit rate.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
